component.name: YACE
component.summary: Fast, light, terminal-native multi-root code editor

description.p: YACE is a code editor for the terminal with VS Code's keys and concepts. It opens multi-root workspaces (including VS Code and Cursor .code-workspace files) and stays light: about 9 MiB of memory at idle.

ul.li: Explorer, fuzzy Quick Open and the Command Palette
Workspace search and replace with a before/after preview
Integrated terminal with split panes and scrollback search
Language servers: completion, hover, go to definition, rename
Git: status, gutter changes, diffs, commit and branches
Tree-sitter highlighting, folding, themes and native plugins
